Locally served browser dependencies

htmx.org 2.0.11 (0BSD), dist/htmx.min.js
cytoscape 3.33.1 (MIT), dist/cytoscape.min.js
Tailwind CSS 3.4.19 (MIT), compiled utility stylesheet at ../tailwind.css

JS files come from the corresponding versioned npm distributions. The Tailwind
stylesheet is generated with only the utilities used by the Jinja HTML templates.
Runtime image builds and the application require no Node tooling.
